slides.title: Coming soon: Evals
slides.summary: Tests for AI systems, so every change is measured, not guessed. This chapter is on its way.
body: An eval is a test for an AI system: a set of inputs, what a good output looks like, and a way to grade it. Without evals, every prompt or model change is a guess.

ul: Building a test set from real cases
Graders: code checks, an LLM as judge, human review
Evaluating agents: did it finish, and how
